# Volts & VINs (https://voltsandvins.com)

> Volts & VINs is a direct-to-consumer online used-Tesla retailer where buyers purchase and reserve from 5,601 clean-title Teslas 100% online (859 priced $500+ below mileage-adjusted peer benchmarks) with upfront out-the-door pricing, $0 price lock, online financing or cash checkout, and insured home delivery across all 50 states.

## Key Online Dealership Facts
- **Published VIN-Decoded Catalog**: 5,601 used Tesla vehicles (Model Y, Model 3, Model S, Model X, Cybertruck)
- **Peer-Benchmarked Price Finds**: 859 listings priced `$500+` below mileage-adjusted peer asking prices (minimum 5 comparable peers in the same model, year, trim, drivetrain, and mileage band)
- **VIN-Decoded Specifications**: Listings include VIN-derived build factory and drivetrain where decoded, with recorded mileage and vehicle location. Build factory is not the current vehicle location
- **Purchase & Reservation Model**: Direct online purchase and reservation through Volts & VINs. Start with a $0 price lock, verify clean title and inspection details, then place a refundable $250 deposit to complete your order and arrange delivery.
